Spanish

Pronunciation

 
  • IPA(key): /ʝaˈmaɾse/ [ɟ͡ʝaˈmaɾ.se]
  • IPA(key): /ʝaˈmaɾse/ [ɟ͡ʝaˈmaɾ.se] (Spain, most of Latin America, Equatorial Guinea)
  • IPA(key): /ʎaˈmaɾse/ [ʎaˈmaɾ.se] (rustic northern Spain, northern and central Andes Mountains (except central Ecuador), Bolivia, Paraguay, northeastern Argentina, Philippines)
  • IPA(key): /ʃaˈmaɾse/ [ʃaˈmaɾ.se] (Buenos Aires and environs)
  • IPA(key): /ʒaˈmaɾse/ [ʒaˈmaɾ.se] (central Ecuador, Santiago del Estero and environs, elsewhere in Pampas and southern Argentina, Uruguay)

  • Rhymes: -aɾse
  • Syllabification: lla‧mar‧se

Verb

llamarse

  1. infinitive of llamar combined with se
